vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you do every morning
vocabulary.example: My morning routine takes one hour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you always do in the same way
vocabulary.example: Drinking tea is my morning ritual.
I get ready for school at seven.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making your arms, legs and body long to loosen muscles
vocabulary.example: I do some stretching after I wake up.

vocabulary.meaning_en: take air into your body and let it out
someone who likes something very much
vocabulary.example: I'm a big fan of fresh juice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: toast with mashed avocado on top
vocabulary.example: I eat avocado toast for breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: eggs mixed and cooked in a pan
a drink with protein, often after sport
vocabulary.example: He drinks a protein shake after the gym.
Eat well and take care of yourself.

vocabulary.note_ar: get some exercise = يمارس بعض الرياضة
vocabulary.example: I get some exercise every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea about what someone should do

fine_lines.title: exhausting vs exhausted
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصفة التي تنتهي بـ ing تصف الشيء المسبب للشعور (العمل مرهِق)، والتي تنتهي بـ ed تصف شعور الشخص (أنا متعَب).
fine_lines.explanation_en: -ing describes the thing (work is exhausting). -ed describes how a person feels (I'm exhausted).

examples.sentence: Eight hours of coding is exhausting.

fine_lines.title: wake up vs get ready
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wake up تعني تستيقظ من النوم، و get ready تعني تجهّز نفسك للخروج (تغتسل، تلبس...).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Wake up = stop sleeping. Get ready = prepare to go out.

examples.sentence: Then I get ready for work.

expressions.phrase: What time do you usually wake up?
expressions.example: What time do you usually wake up? At 6:00.

expressions.phrase: I have a morning routine that I like to follow.
expressions.meaning_ar: لديّ روتين صباحي أحب أن ألتزم به.
expressions.meaning_en: Say you have regular morning habits.
expressions.example: I have a morning routine that I like to follow.
You work twelve hours? That sounds exhausting.

expressions.phrase: start my day on the right foot
expressions.meaning_en: Begin the day in a good way.
expressions.example: A good breakfast helps me start my day on the right foot.

expressions.phrase: I can see how that would be helpful.
expressions.meaning_ar: أفهم كيف يمكن أن يكون ذلك مفيدًا.
expressions.meaning_en: Agree that an idea is useful.
expressions.example: Walking in the morning? I can see how that would be helpful.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you like something very much.
expressions.example: I'm a big fan of mint tea.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you will remember someone's advice.
expressions.example: Drink more water. I'll keep that in mind.
Thanks for the advice. No problem!

grammar.title: Present simple + usually for routines
grammar.explanation_ar: المضارع البسيط مع usually للعادات اليومية: I usually wake up around 9:00. وفي السؤال: What time do you usually wake up?
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple + usually for daily habits.
examples: What time do you usually wake up?
I usually make myself a big breakfast.
I usually just have a protein shake.

grammar.title: Telling time: at / around
grammar.explanation_ar: at 6:00 = في السادسة تمامًا. around 9:00 = حوالي التاسعة (تقريبًا).
grammar.explanation_en: at = exact time; around = about, not exact.
examples: I wake up at 6:00 in the morning.
We have lunch around one o'clock.

grammar.title: help + someone + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد help نستخدم المفعول ثم الفعل في أصله: A hot shower helps me wake up.
examples: A hot shower helps me wake up.
Stretching helps me start my day.

questions.question: What time do you usually ___ up?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد do you نستخدم الفعل في أصله: wake.
questions.explanation_en: After "do you" use the base verb.

questions.question: I wake up ___ 6:00 in the morning.
Eight hours of coding is ___.
questions.explanation_ar: نصف الشيء المسبب للتعب بـ ing: exhausting.

questions.question: A hot shower helps me ___ up.
Thanks for the advice! — ___
questions.explanation_ar: No problem رد ودّي على الشكر.

questions.question: "I'll keep that in mind" means...
questions.explanation_en: It means I will remember it.

questions.question: Stretching makes your body...
questions.explanation_en: Stretching makes your muscles long and loose.

questions.question: I'm a big ___ of avocado toast.
questions.explanation_ar: a big fan of = من محبّي.
questions.explanation_en: "A big fan of" = like very much.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: usually قبل الفعل، والفعل مع I بدون s.
questions.explanation_en: Usually goes before the verb; no -s with I.
